input.summary: Keep the existing Termination Payment calculation but cap it at three months' Section 3.1 fees and confirm it is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.
input.comment: [Playbook] We retained the existing calculation (including the $800,000 deduction and halving) and added only a proviso capping the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees, plus a new Section 4.2(d) confirming it is the only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount we owe.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

ops.text: The Termination Payment is the only early-termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.
